metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by apostoldevel: skills for the Apostol ecosystem — libapostol (C++20) + db-platform (PostgreSQL/PL/pgSQL) — and for running development with a named team of agents. One plugin per skill, each versioned on its own.

plugins.name: apostol-project
plugins.description: Working context for projects built on Apostol — libapostol + db-platform: architecture, boundaries, DB patterns, access control, anti-patterns, verification, a reading route per role.

plugins.name: apostol
plugins.description: Framework development for Apostol — libapostol (C++20), db-platform (PostgreSQL/PL/pgSQL), shared C++ modules and processes: the submodule loop, the specification as the map, process model, plug-in contract, the contracts a platform change must keep.

plugins.name: agent-team
plugins.description: Development as a visible named team of Claude Code agents: roles, a git board, a working day on the owner's word, the owner's word by record — with tested hook templates (write barrier, briefing, context guard, output filter).
